subject.title: Add the new sandbox kiddo (agx.so) in the block as a provider

question: Should Crabbox sponsor AGX as a provisional built-in SSH-only provider before AGX publishes stable authentication, ownership, inventory, and release contracts?
rationale: The adapter shape is technically bounded, but accepting it now would establish user-visible BYO-key, provisioning-on-connect, local-only release, and idle-reclamation semantics from incomplete early-access documentation.

options.title: Wait for stable AGX contracts
options.body: Keep the request open and revisit implementation when AGX documents authentication and lifecycle behavior and a real create-to-release flow can be proven.

options.title: Sponsor provisional SSH support
options.body: Explicitly accept an early-access built-in provider contract and require redacted current-service lifecycle proof before landing a new narrow implementation.

recommendation.title: Wait for stable AGX contracts
recommendation.body: Keep the request open and revisit implementation when AGX documents authentication and lifecycle behavior and a real create-to-release flow can be proven.

likelyOwner.reason: The available provider-hardening history and issue timeline make this person the strongest available routing candidate for the built-in-provider acceptance decision.
